## 108:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-song. A-psalm of-David. Steady my-heart O-God; I-will-sing and-I-will-make-music, also my-glory.
- **LOGOS:** A Song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God! I will sing and make melody with all my being!
- **PNEUMA:** A song. A psalm of David. My heart is confident, God! I will sing! I will make music with everything I've got!
